'''Metanol''' was a substance that could be carried by [[container transport]]s.

Container transport [[Kempman group|''Kempman'']] was part of a relief convoy that was destroyed at the [[battle of Organarms]] while carrying metanol at some point before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].
